newsitem.title: USA: Krause's files 4.4 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: Krause's files 4.4 mln share offer.

text.p: Krause's Furniture Inc said Tuesday it had filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of 4.4 million shares.

None of the shares are held by the company. All are "restricted securities" that could be sold under Rule 144 of the Securities Act of 1933, it said. The shares include those held by a group of investors who participated in a previous private placement of Krause's common stock.
Krause's said it would receive no proceeds from the sale and there would be no dilution for existing shareholders.
It said it expected the registration would become effective by the end of March.
Krause's makes and sells custom-crafted furniture.
